scouts.summary: I found 7 candidates. Three meet the rule that the US-stock cost is about a third of a price other sellers prove they get: the soft back-seat hammock, the SUV cargo liner and the front seat cover. All three are commodity soft goods. Prices of $70 to $110 are proven only for brands with reviews (4Knines, Ruff Liners, Team K9), and most Amazon volume sells at $20 to $46. The hammock is the best Black Friday learning product. It is light, easy to film, and creators already sell it for 4Knines and PetsVet Supply. The other items fit better as add-ons to the extender. Door covers have no US source, and the back-seat bed, custom portrait and car ramp fail the cost test. The biggest finding is about the hero itself: AliExpress US cards today showed hard-bottom extenders at $47.31 and $48.92 with free shipping and 6-day delivery tags. The Nov 21 ranking used $76.99, so this needs a supplier check. Nothing was bought, sent or logged into.

top3.why: US stock $24.58 (473 sold) against a proposed $69 kit; 4Knines sells at $79.99 and Ruff Liners at $109.99 with Amazon volume. Creator ads exist in this category. The risk is that generics sell for $24 to $34.

US stock $21.42 against a proposed $69. 4Knines and Team K9 list it at $79.99, and Amazon XL liners at $90 to $96 sell 200+ a month. The cheap source has no sales, and Google search demand is tiny (320 a month).
US stock $15.45 against 4Knines at $44.99, which sells 200+ a month on Amazon with 1,800 ratings. It works only as an order-value add-on: weak creator hook, and the US source has 3 sales.

scouts.summary: I found 8 holiday-gift products and wrote them to the JSON and MD files. Two meet the one-third cost rule against a price other sellers already get. The rolling knife sharpener costs $13.07 from US stock. Generics sell on Amazon at $33.99 (6,000+ bought past month), a TikTok Shop listing shows 10,783 sold at $39, and small DTC stores (Hatori, NorthernKnife) sell at $79.95 to $99.90 with Meta ads running. The monitor light bar costs $8.85 from US stock against Quntis at $33.96 on Amazon and $41.99 to $43.99 on its own store. The salt and pepper grinder set passes on paper ($10.55 against $39.97), but every US card showed about 1 unit left. The smoker kit, car vacuum, pressure washer, meat thermometer and bird feeder fail: US cost is 46% to 115% of the proven price. All costs are AliExpress search-card prices, not supplier quotes. TikTok sold counts come from Google snippets. Nothing was bought or contacted. The top two can be bought as 10 to 20 units and shipped from home.

top3.why: US cost $13.07 is 19% of the proposed $69 kit and 34 to 38% of proven $34 to $39 prices. Strong creator demo, Meta advertisers active, light, no battery. Stock thin; patents not cleared.
US cost $8.85 is 20% of a proposed $44.99 kit and 26% of the Quntis Amazon price. Tech-worker gift with steady demand all year. TikTok sells it at $24 to $37, which caps price.
US cost $10.55 is 26% of ThermoMaven's $39.97 Amazon price (3,000+ a month). Strong December search peak. But US cards show about 1 unit in stock, so the cost is not repeatable today.

scouts.summary: I scanned 24 Amazon keywords through DataForSEO, 14 AliExpress US-stock searches, the public Printful catalog and shipping prices, 7 store products.json files and Google search volumes. That produced 8 candidates. Only one meets the one-third rule at a price another seller proves: a dog carrier backpack kit. A US-stock card shows $25.99 with free shipping, against Kurgo G-Train at $79.99 with 200+ bought in the past month, and it fits Barkfare. The large custom pet portrait canvas from Printful comes next: $44.45 landed for 18x24 against Crown and Paw's $99.95, and $62.81 for 24x36 against $159.95. It overlaps the barkfare-addons canvas and should be ranked with it as one product. Everything else costs half the proven price or more on US stock, the same problem as the 36. The metal detector, starlight headliner, window robot and tufting kit are here mainly because creators could sell them. Most costs are AliExpress first-order promo prices. TikTok Shop, Foreplay and most Meta Ad Library checks were blocked.

top3.why: Only candidate at about one third: $25.99 US-stock card with free shipping against Kurgo $79.99 (200+ bought/mo). Fits the Barkfare customer, creator fit 5. The listing has no sold count or reviews, so a sample is needed.
Printed in the US by Printful: $33.66 plus $10.79 shipping against Crown & Paw's $99.95 (16x24), and the 24x36 size against $159.95. Merge with the barkfare-addons canvas.
Strong demand (90,500 searches/mo, 110,000 in Dec). Amazon listing at $104.49 with 1,000+ bought/mo. Creator fit 5. The $48.45 US cost is a first-order promo price, so cost is about half the price.

checks.rule_or_ip_problem: 4Knines LLC owns design patents titled 'Seat cover with floor hammock', 'Split bench seat cover' and USD1116542S1 'Split cover for a vehicle interior'. This comes from Google Patents snippets; the patents were not opened. US7677662B2 covers a hammock-style seat cover, status UNKNOWN. Ruff Liners holds US 12,221,024 on door flaps. Avoid split-bench or floor-hammock look-alikes.

Snippets list K9 Sport Sack LLC as owner of utility patents US10617096B2 (pet backpack with a head collar opening) and US12453333B2 (granted 2025-10-28), and design patents USD1013285S1 and USD876826S1. checks.rule_or_ip_problem: Many listings say 'Adults & Kids', so we must sell to adults only (children's products are out of scope). The #1 Amazon detector is a kids' kit. The SUNPOW model has a 1,500 mAh lithium battery (handheld, not worn). FCC papers are needed. Long 5.8 lb box.
checks.corrected_values: The cited card now shows $46.69, still a new-shopper price. A non-promo sibling card (3256811951167885) shows $48.39 with 51 sold and free shipping; whether it matches the spec is UNKNOWN. Price proven by volume: $55.65 to $71. $104.49 comes from one seller.
checks.evidence: Gbnryg sells at $104.49 with 1,000+ a month (VERIFIED). Other adult detectors: GoGonova $56.98 (1,000+), $67.98 with LCD (800+), Bounty Hunter $71 (1,000+), SUNPOW $55.65 (500+), all VERIFIED. A Temu snippet shows $74.85. Search demand: 'metal detector' 90,500 a month, 'metal detector for adults' 260.

refute.bottom_line: None of the nine holds up fully. Each 'proven' price belongs to a brand (4Knines, Ruff Liners, Kurgo, Quntis, ThermoMaven, Crown & Paw, Gbnryg). Generic versions sell with volume at one third to one half of that, often near our US cost. Two US costs can't be repeated: the cargo liner and grinder cards show 1 left. The knife sharpener's $13.07 card shows only 3 left, so its repeatable cost is $15.15. K9 Sport Sack and 4Knines patents sit near the backpack and the seat covers. Strongest left: the rolling knife sharpener ($15.15 against $33.99 with 6,000+ a month and a December peak), pending a HORL patent check. Next is the pet canvas (cost confirmed; high price proven only by Crown & Paw). Notes: /home/user/commerce-os/research/launch-plan-2026-11-22/04_skeptic_products.md
